build_ShadowUNet: build a ShadowUNet model to predict shadow maps from ambient occlusion input tensors
build_FloorShadowDecoder: build a FloorShadowDecoder model to generate shadow maps from ambient occlusion maps
build_ShadowUNet_PoseCond: build a pose-conditioned ShadowUNet model to predict shadow maps using AO maps and pose vectors
build_PoseToShadow: build a PoseToShadow model to generate shadow maps directly from pose vectors
build_DistMapShadowUNet: build a DistMapShadowUNet model to predict shadow maps from joint distance map tensors
